question: How is the second image imagined?
premises: Imagine the vidyā-image, then self-named, second.
In middle Bhairava true-being; on right Rati-crest.
inference: The second image is imagined with Bhairava true-being in the middle and Rati-crest on the right.
plain_english: Imagine the vidyā-image, then self-named, second; in the middle Bhairava true-being, on the right Rati-crest.
